say:1:1536130001:1.text: Hmph. Look at their builds, their posture, their eyes—none of them look like warriors!
say:1:1536130001:1.source_cn: 哼，你看看他们的体格，气魄，还有姿态，哪都不像个战士！

say:2:1536130002:1.text: Back in my day, every contender was a master hunter! We killed boars by the dozen and brought eagles down from the sky without blinking!

say:2:1536130002:1.female: Back in my day, every contender was a master hunter! We killed boars by the dozen and brought eagles down from the sky without blinking!

say:3:1536130003:1.text: This lot wouldn't have lasted a day! If I were younger, I'd have taken the crown myself!
